title: Shared definitions for extraction-evaluation records
description: Definitions referenced by the expectation, observation and run schemas. Not a record kind itself.

page_number.description: 1-based physical page index within the PDF. Never a printed label.

level.description: Uncertainty about the stated value; 'high' means the value should not be scored strictly.

title.description: Document title as printed; empty only when the document has none.

page_count.description: Physical page count of the PDF.

corpus_id.description: Optional id of the pinned corpus entry (benchmarks/public_pdfs/sources.json).

physical_pages.description: The physical pages this record covers. A complete document lists every page.

coordinate_system.description: Frame of this page's bounding boxes. 'frame' says which orientation they use. 'unrotated': the named page box before the PDF /Rotate entry is applied (what PyMuPDF get_text returns on a page whose rotation has not been removed; page.rect is then the rotated box); width/height are the unrotated box dimensions. 'displayed': the page as shown, rotation applied (what pymupdf4llm yields, because to_markdown calls page.remove_rotation() and page.rotation then reads 0); width/height are the displayed dimensions. Read geometry from a separately opened document, or declare 'displayed'. 'rotation' is always the PDF's stored /Rotate value (0/90/180/270, clockwise), read from a separately opened document, so a viewer can relate the frames. Unit 'px' is always the displayed render.

unit.description: pt = PDF points (1/72 in); px = pixels of the identified render (page.render with dpi required); normalized = fractions of the frame, so width and height are exactly 1.

origin.description: Corner at which x=0,y=0; y increases away from the origin.

box.description: PDF page box the frame is measured against.

image_sha256.description: Hash of the rendered page image the record was derived from or reviewed against.

block_id.description: Block that starts (or ends) the meaningful body on this page.

page.description: 'render' is required in expectations and, for observations, whenever geometry.unit is px; otherwise optional (a Markdown-only extractor has no render). Observations still need geometry and page attribution.

printed_label.description: Page label printed on the page (e.g. 'iv', '17'); null when the page shows none. Distinct from physical_page.

render.description: The displayed (rotation applied) page image. pt/normalized boxes map onto it through geometry.rotation.

bbox.description: Interpreted in the coordinate_system of the block's page; x0<=x1 and y0<=y1 in that system.

block.description: 'bbox' is required in expectations and optional in observations. A block lives on one page; content spanning pages is a chain of blocks linked by continues_from.

truncated.description: Content cut off at the scope boundary of a page-scoped record (the block starts before or ends after the sampled pages).

continues_from.description: Id of the block this one continues from: same type, later in reading order and on the same or a later page, at most one continuation per block. For a table chain, cell row indices restart at 0 in each fragment, the logical table is the fragments' rows concatenated in chain order, n_cols must be equal across fragments, and a header row repeated on a continuation page is marked is_header.

output_span.description: Observations only. Where this block landed in the extractor's Markdown output: half-open character offsets (Unicode code points) into the text whose SHA-256 is markdown_sha256. span_sha256 is the hash of that slice, for exact round-trip checks.

id.description: Stable within the record; never reused for a different block.

reading_order.description: Position in the document-wide reading order; unique per record. Blocks outside the reading flow (running headers) still receive one.

text.description: Exact text, verbatim: signs, decimals, operators and case preserved. null = block has no textual content to compare.

text_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the UTF-8 bytes of text, no normalization.

caption_for.description: Only on type 'caption': id of the table/figure block it captions.

year_raw.description: Year exactly as printed (e.g. '2020a', 'in press'); year holds the numeric reading, if any.

target_status.description: resolved = entry_ids lists the targets; no_target = the document's reference list has no matching entry; out_of_scope = the target lies on a page outside this page-scoped record, so it cannot be judged here.

entry_ids.description: Reference entries the marker points to; non-empty exactly when target_status is resolved.
